tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Brand foundation. Page ground in the dark theme, text on light grounds, major hero and cover surfaces. Fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: midnight-800
tokens.usage: Raised surface on midnight: panels, cards and table bands on dark grounds.

tokens.name: midnight-700
tokens.usage: Second raised step on midnight; large decorative fields and module fills. Not for text.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Primary accent as a FILL: the Convergence upper band, signal pages (one per document), the symbol, key data marks. 4.1:1 on midnight, so text in it uses cobalt-600 or cobalt-300.

tokens.name: cobalt-600
tokens.usage: Action fill with white text (5.8:1): primary buttons. Also cobalt text on light grounds (5.4:1 on off-white).

tokens.name: cobalt-300
tokens.usage: Cobalt text and links on midnight and midnight-800 (7.0:1 or better).

tokens.name: mineral
tokens.usage: Secondary accent as a FILL: the Convergence lower band, the final stage, the outcome node. 7.4:1 on midnight; 2.5:1 on white, so never text on light.

tokens.name: mineral-700
tokens.usage: Mineral text on off-white and white (4.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: mineral-300
tokens.usage: Mineral text on midnight and midnight-800 (9.0:1 or better).

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: Primary light surface: page ground in the light theme, light panels, text on midnight.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Supporting light surface: raised cards on off-white, report pages, print.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white and off-white (7.0:1 or better). Fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: slate-300
tokens.usage: Secondary text on midnight and midnight-800 (8.0:1 or better). Fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: line-light
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline on white and off-white. Not a control border (1.3:1).

tokens.name: line-dark
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline on midnight. Not a control border.

tokens.name: stroke-light
tokens.usage: Control and diagram strokes that carry meaning on white and off-white (3.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: stroke-dark
tokens.usage: Control and diagram strokes that carry meaning on midnight and midnight-800 (3.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background in each theme.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised panels and cards on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted bands: a midnight band in the light theme, an off-white band in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-100 and surface-200 (17:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-100 and surface-200 (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and selected state.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action (5.8:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and highlighted words on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: mineral-text
tokens.usage: Engineering and success labels on surface-100 and surface-200; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and grid rules on surface grounds.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and meaningful diagram strokes (3:1 or better on surface-100 and surface-200).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with a 2px offset; 5.4:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text on cobalt signal fields: headlines and labels (4.5:1). Set body copy on cobalt-600 instead (5.8:1).

tokens.name: on-mineral
tokens.usage: Text on mineral fields and bands (7.4:1).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One word or a three-line statement at full bleed: homepage hero, chapter openers, banners. Never more than 12 words.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Report cover titles, slide titles, statement pages.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section statements, social tiles, slide titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Vitalos helps organisations assess opportunities, design the right systems and operate them with confidence.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and hero supporting copy.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Tables, captions beside figures, form help.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headings and on diagram nodes. Apply text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Annotation layer only: figure labels, rulers, document references, stage codes. Uppercase.

styles.name: mono-data
styles.usage: Reference numbers, hex values, coordinates, contact details on cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inline control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop; editorial whitespace.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for panels, report modules, diagrams and images.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tags and small containers.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon and social avatar tiles, matching the supplied icon set.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and node markers only.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Grid rules, table rules, panel dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-path
tokens.usage: Path and connector lines in diagrams.

tokens.name: stroke-node
tokens.usage: Outline of hollow (pending) nodes.

tokens.name: layout-columns
tokens.usage: Column count for web and slide grids.

tokens.name: layout-container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on the website.

tokens.name: layout-gutter
tokens.usage: Column gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: path-angle
tokens.usage: Diagonals stand at 60 degrees from horizontal, as in the symbol, or 30 degrees when the Convergence faces forward. No other angles.

tokens.name: band-angle
tokens.usage: The Convergence bands' slope: the symbol turned to face forward.

tokens.name: band-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the two Convergence bands as a fraction of one band's thickness (min 4px).
